title: scale-ncsc-nl: 1 smaller precision and sourcing point
description: The cited capture carries no counts: ncsc-nl-php2shell-software-list text.txt (sha 83f3aa60...) is the index page with letter links only. The counts rest on files under sources/ncsc-nl-php2shell/raw/, a source the claim does not cite (numbers.json n-674 does). The tree files are not listed in raw/SHA256SUMS; this desk verified them against the bundle, which is.
